dedupe_keys.name: supplementary data for the publication impact of hydrogen blending constraints on electrolyser operation and hydrogen production costs a case study of a regional gas grid section in austria

description: An Austrian Institute of Technology team publishes simulation inputs and results for hydrogen blending in a regional gas-grid section. Zenodo provides five ZIP files under CC BY-NC 4.0. The DynANA portion includes pipes and nodes, nodal gas-demand series, hydrogen injection profiles and simulated pressure and concentration. IESopt archives hold upstream and downstream electrolyser dispatch results for three electricity-price years and blending-constraint cases. These files can benchmark coupled gas-network and power-to-hydrogen planning simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this study bundle. Coverage is the selected Austrian network and scenario years, not all national gas pipelines. A limitation is that modelled pressure and costs depend on the supplied grid, injection and price assumptions; they are not independent operational measurements. DynANA and IESopt are separate software dependencies. The archives were not downloaded, and the optimisation or dynamic gas results were not rerun.
